game.desc: Ben 10: Alien Force: Vilgax Attacks on Xbox 360 is an action-adventure game based on the animated series of the same name. You play as Ben Tennyson, a young teenager accompanied by ten alien superheroes. You must save the world from the dreadful Vilgax, Ben's worst enemy, who wants to conquer the universe planet after planet.
